children: Aquestive Therapeutics disclosed an investor presentation detailing an NDA resubmission for Anaphylm and its cash runway of $98.5 million.
NDA resubmitted for Anaphylm (dibutepinephrine) sublingual film on Sept 17, 2026; company requests expedited FDA review.
Company says resubmission addresses FDA Complete Response Letter issues from Jan 30, 2026, but FDA may require more data.
Cash and equivalents of $98.5M as of June 30, 2026; access to $75M from RTW and $20M from Oaktree contingent on FDA approval.
Projects Anaphylm peak annual revenue >$1B and positions it as first non-device orally delivered epinephrine candidate if approved.
Pursuing ex-U.S. filings: Canada filing planned by end of 2026 and EU filing in Q1 2027; commercial launch planning underway.
This is an AI-powered summary. It may contain inaccuracies. Consider verifying important information with the source. Please note this summary is solely based on documents filed with the SEC.

title: Aquestive Therapeutics posts investor presentation; NDA resubmission for Anaphylm, $98.5M cash
